en-US: - Fixed the pairing QR scanner: it could fail to detect a code on the first scan, and invalid codes now show a clear error instead of doing nothing. - 📻 Public Radio is now available directly on the Pairing screen—listen instantly, with no need for an editor, QR code, or pairing. - Added a true light mode! Choose System, Light, or Dark in Settings > Appearance—your choice is saved and applied instantly throughout the app. - Added a True Light Mode! Choose System, Light, or Dark in Settings > Appearance—your choice is saved and applied instantly throughout the app.
pt-BR: - Corrigido o leitor de QR de pareamento: ele podia falhar ao detectar um código na primeira leitura, e códigos inválidos agora mostram um erro claro em vez de não fazer nada. - 📻 Public Radio is now available right from the Pair device screen — listen instantly, no publisher, QR code, or pairing needed. - Added a real Light Mode! Choose System, Light, or Dark in Settings > Appearance — your pick is saved and applied instantly across the app. - Adicionado um Modo Claro de verdade! Escolha Sistema, Claro ou Escuro em Configurações > Aparência — sua escolha é salva e aplicada na hora em todo o app.
